bio.CareerHighlightsSingles:
During 2025, finished R-Up at World Tennis W35 Roehampton (l. Vandromme in F)

In 2024, won her first WTA Tour main draw match at Guangzhou (l. Bouzas Maneiro and also reached R16 as a qualifier at Hong Kong (l. Pera)

Made her WTA Tour debut at Beijing 2024 with a main draw wild card (l. Uchijima in 1r)

Began on the ITF circuit proper in 2022, making her first final in 2023 at W15 Tianjin; claimed her first ITF title in 2024 at W50 Anning before earning a further two that season at W50 Taizhou and W35 Kunshan
bio.CurrentYearDetail:
Played 1r at Beijing (as qualifier, l. eventual champion Zheng Qinwen)

Earned 4th World Tennis title of the year at W15 Tianjin-CHN in August

Won 3rd World Tennis title of the year at W50 Elvas-POR in July

Claimed two World Tennis titles in Monastir-TUN during February, and finished R-Up at World Tennis W35 Luzhou-CHN in April
